suite.name: formal_detail_mix_busi_v1
suite.purpose: Second source dataset. Tests on new data whether the detail branch replicates and whether adding global_mix on top of detail helps, a question raised (not settled) by the Kvasir Test results.
suite.prompt: a tumor in a breast ultrasound image
suite.prompt_note: One fixed sentence for every image, including normal images. The original BUSI lists describe normal images as "No tumor", which reveals that the mask is empty; that text is never used here.
suite.hyperparameters: identical to formal_detail_mix_kvasir_v1 (config derived from it; only dataset, seed and sentence differ)
suite.small_target_definition: positive image with foreground fraction <= BUSI Train positive 25th percentile (computed at lock, then fixed)
suite.final_model_rule: Fixed before training. The combination becomes the final model only if combination_adds passes here AND combination_adds_five_seed passes in formal_detail_mix_kvasir_v2. Otherwise the final model is detail alone. Statistic for every criterion: mean over seeds of paired differences in percentage points.
reported_not_gating: positive-image DSC and normal-image false positives (BUSI contains normal images; an empty prediction on an empty mask scores 100)
image-level permutation and Wilcoxon tests, bootstrap intervals, per-seed signs, gain concentration
unique-image sensitivity and any exact image overlap between test sets and BUSI Train/Val
